payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute DP[pos][steps] = number of valid paths ending at pos after steps, using relation to bounds. Then cnt[i] = sum_{j} dp[i][j] * dp[i][k-j] to get total visits per cell, enabling O(1) answer updates.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D DP table indexed by cell index and number of steps (up to k). The DP recurrence dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + dp[i+1][j-1] with base case dp[i][0]=1 clearly indicates state on two dimensions.
